title: Generative AI, not AI
subtitle: What the book means by generative AI, how a language model works in plain words, where hallucinations come from, and where Dinis was corrected. 12 panels.
book_version: v1.0.0 is the only official version; the second edition is in release candidates (rc1 and rc2 frozen)
by: gen-z.journalist, 18 October 2026, from Dinis's memo on generative AI
rule: Every line the Guide says, and every quote card, is from the article 'Generative AI, not AI', word for word; the build checks it. The next-word probabilities in panel 4 are illustrative.

scenes.title: Generative AI, not AI
scenes.subtitle: The technology this book is about is the one that generates.

scenes.caption: AI has become a huge bucket, and to be honest the word gets abused a lot.

scenes.caption: Predicting the next word

cast.says: what happens is that it predicts the next word

scenes.note: The percentages are illustrative. Strictly, the next token: a piece of a word.

scenes.caption: Why a better prompt helps

cast.says: the better your prompt, the better the output

scenes.note: The prompt steers which concepts the model draws on; it does not change the model.
scenes.source: Generative AI, not AI, How I understand it
